name: com.pancakedevs.apexphysics
description: A PC-first Unity physics framework with a playable Rigidbody desktop rig, polished force-driven player interaction, streamlined current-player tooling, editor-generated destruction, synchronized water, buoyancy, reusable grabbable objects, warehouse systems, navigation, lighting workflows, and package updates. Legacy physical-NPC editor commands are hidden from the current player workflow while compatibility code remains available to older scenes.

samples.description: Starter content for testing Apex physics components.
Optional URP low-poly water shader with depth color, foam, caustics, and refraction.
